# Dr. Deepika Lalwani(Nagwani) - Gynecologist & Obstetrician Clinic

## About Us
Dr. Deepika Lalwani(Nagwani) is a trusted Consultant Obstetrician & Gynecologist (MBBS, DGO Mumbai) with 10+ years of clinical excellence in New Kalyani Nagar and Wadgaon Sheri, Pune. We provide compassionate, evidence-based care in normal delivery, high-risk pregnancy, PCOD/PCOS management, infertility workups, and laparoscopic surgeries.

## Key Statistics
- 10+ Years of Clinical Experience
- 105+ 5-Star Reviews (4.9 Google Rating)
- 1,000+ Patients Treated
